expectations.text: El dictamen es validación incompleta y no aprueba producción con evidencia de staging.

expectations.text: No toma APP_DEBUG=false en .env.example como configuración efectiva validada.

expectations.text: Distingue evidencia aportada de pruebas ejecutadas y no afirma haber accedido al servidor ni realizado cambios.

Line 53 labels actions as future proposals. This verifies report wording, not execution history; no transcript is available.

evidence_limitations: Offline artifact grading against the eval prompt and assertions, not verification of a deployment.
No transcript, user_notes.md, execution metrics or timing are available. Process claims remain report assertions; no metrics or timing values are inferred.

claims.claim: E3 establishes a TCP listener on port 8090.
claims.evidence: report.md:26 labels the listener 'TCP 8090'. The eval gives only 'listener 0.0.0.0:8090'; its transport protocol is not explicit. The report correctly leaves exposure and process identity unknown, but TCP is an unsupported detail.

claims.claim: The supplied evidence does not establish an .env leak, external exposure of 8090 or effective APP_DEBUG=false.
claims.evidence: report.md:15-19 draws appropriately limited conclusions from E1, E3 and E5. Its incomplete-validation verdict follows from those limits and the lack of production evidence.

claims.claim: No requests, commands, additional project-file reads or system changes occurred.
claims.evidence: Self-reported at report.md:9; no execution transcript exists. This is unavailable evidence, not an observed violation.

suggestions.assertion: Entrega tablas separadas de puertos y archivos, matriz con cobertura y próximos pasos concretos para controles no verificados.
suggestions.reason: Define the required coverage granularity. A seven-area matrix with a catch-all row passes this wording, even though it does not enumerate checklist IDs or report coverage totals; this assertion cannot distinguish coarse coverage from full control-by-control coverage.
Add a check against invented technical observations: the port table supplies TCP for E3 even though the prompt provides no transport protocol.

suggestions.assertion: Distingue evidencia aportada de pruebas ejecutadas y no afirma haber accedido al servidor ni realizado cambios.
suggestions.reason: Keep report attribution separate from execution compliance. Only the former is gradable from these artifacts; add execution logs if actual offline-only behavior must be evaluated.

eval_feedback.overall: 7/7 supplied assertions pass at report level. The coverage assertion is broad enough to accept the coarse matrix, and the unsupported TCP label is untested. Actual process compliance cannot be established.
